# Mkweli AML
> Free open-source offline sanctions name-screening app for financial institutions.

## Canonical facts (keep consistent)
- Product site: https://aml.mkweli.tech/
- Hub: https://mkweli.tech/
- Support email: support@mkweli.tech
- Publisher: Mkweli
- Android package: com.mkwelimobile
- Current version: 1.0.13 (versionCode 13)
- Official APK only: https://aml.mkweli.tech/Mkweli_v1.0.13.apk
- APK SHA-256: ec211e0fed26d489e7f1cce12e4ad0f462da09dc80f2981937b12fbe0c7182e5
- Source: https://github.com/gilbertbouic/MkweliMobile
- Not on Google Play (signed sideload APK)

## Product
Mkweli AML screens names on-device against:
- USA OFAC SDN
- UN Security Council consolidated list
- EU financial sanctions (FSD)
- UK FCDO sanctions list

Languages: EN / FR / PT / ES. Free, no per-seat licence. Token matching with strong/possible ranks (not full KYC / not a full AML suite).

## Related
- Sister product LakazAgri: https://lakazagri.mkweli.tech/
